## Project: CV Analyzer MVP (Next.js + FastAPI + LangChain)
This is a complete MVP for HR teams to analyze CVs against job profiles using AI.

**Tech Stack:**
- Frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router) + TypeScript + TailwindCSS
- Backend: Python 3.11, FastAPI, LangChain, OpenAI
- File Processing: PyMuPDF, python-docx, pdfminer.six
- Storage: Local disk (MVP), CSV/PDF exports

**Key Features:**
- Create job profiles with weighted skills
- Upload multiple CVs (PDF/DOC/DOCX)
- AI-powered candidate analysis and scoring
- Sortable results table with candidate drawer
- Export functionality and data deletion
